def test_no_wrapper_error_retains_import_failures(stubs, modules, monkeypatch):
    stubs.ImportFake(modules, monkeypatch).patch()
    info = machinery._autoselect_wrapper()
    assert info.wrapper is None
    assert info.pyqt6 == \"ImportError: Fake ImportError for PyQt6.\"
    assert info.pyqt5 == \"ImportError: Fake ImportError for PyQt5.\"
    with pytest.raises(machinery.NoWrapperAvailableError) as excinfo:
        raise machinery.NoWrapperAvailableError(info)
    assert excinfo.value.info is info
    assert str(excinfo.value) == \"No Qt wrapper was importable.\\n\\n\\n\" + str(info)


def test_selection_info_formats():
    short = machinery.SelectionInfo(
        wrapper=\"PyQt5\", reason=machinery.SelectionReason.default
    )
    assert str(short) == \"Qt wrapper: PyQt5 (via default)\"
    verbose = machinery.SelectionInfo(
        wrapper=\"PyQt5\", reason=machinery.SelectionReason.default,
        pyqt5=\"success\", pyqt6=\"ImportError: missing\",
    )
    assert str(verbose) == (
        \"Qt wrapper info:\\nPyQt5: success\\nPyQt6: ImportError: missing\\n\"
        \"selected: PyQt5 (via default)\"
    )
